answer: The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. An honest proof costs 90 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 814 of them, which totals 73260 POA. The strongest wall I know is Falconry steward goshawk mark flown at the aerie, and it is built out of each goshawk is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record. The farm counts its onyx as a win, its raven as an expense, its signal as a nuisance — and the nuisance is the one it cannot buy off.
